title: Tool profiles and metadata contract
objective: Pin one authoritative tool metadata contract for every canonical MCP tool: surface profile membership, MCP annotations, OAuth scopes or local-only status, effect class, approval class, output bound, and kernel capability shape; derive tool registration, discovery, and remote authorization from it so that each transport and provider sees exactly its profile, unknown tools, profiles, and provider mappings deny by default, and every profile is regression-tested against the kernel's own scope table.

include: a single machine-readable tool contract covering every canonical tool exactly once with profile membership, annotations, scopes or local-only status, effect class, approval class, output bound, and kernel shape
MCP tool annotations (read-only, destructive, idempotent, open-world hints and titles) emitted from the contract on every transport
profile-filtered registration so remote discovery lists only remotely mappable tools while local transports list their full local profile
default deny for unknown tools, unknown profiles, and unmapped provider kinds, with provider-specific allow and deny differences recorded explicitly
regression tests that pin every profile's exact membership and check the contract against the OAuth matrix, the cotrad remote-session scope table, approval behavior, and the parity inventory
exclude: any new tool, kernel shape, scope, or authority
widening any existing profile or enabling a remote mapping for a local-only tool
provider directory submission or provider-specific packaging (SG-000067 through SG-000070)

authority_delta.approval: None; approval classes are recorded, not changed.

invariants: discovery hiding is never authorization: cotrad and the remote ceilings still enforce every call
no profile, provider, or transport gains a tool it could not call before this grain
annotations never claim a tool is read-only, non-destructive, or closed-world when it is not

acceptance.claim: Every canonical tool has exactly one contract entry whose annotations, scopes, effect class, approval class, output bound, and kernel shape are consistent with its implementation and are emitted on every transport.
Each profile's membership is exact and regression-tested, remote discovery lists only remotely mappable tools, and unknown tools, profiles, and provider mappings deny.
Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000066: The P16 security and parity exit may proceed only after SG-000065 closes.

done_when: One tested tool contract drives registration, annotations, discovery, and remote ceilings for every profile, with default deny for anything unmapped.

canonical_evidence.security_review: PASS on exact qualified head: one authoritative tool contract with exactly one entry per canonical tool (kernel shape, effect class, approval class, remote scopes or local-only status, output bound, title, annotations) drives contract-gated registration on every transport (missing entry fails startup, out-of-profile tools are not registered, titles and annotations attached), the derived OAuth matrix and local-only list, and exact profiles: core (26 remote tools, relay) and desktop_structured (core plus 5 local-only tools, stdio and loopback); unmapped and unknown profiles and remote provider kinds fail closed. Closed a discovery leak where the relay advertised local-only tools to remote clients, and bounded the previously unbounded fs_list output at 5000 sorted entries with truncation reported. Tests pin the contract against tool sources, real MCP discovery per transport, the cotrad remote-session scope table, the OAuth matrix, the parity inventory, annotation and approval invariants, and the generated document. No tool, shape, scope, or authority added. All closed SG-000001 through SG-000064 regressions pass. CodeRabbit skipped-review and cubic skipping notices evaluated as non-evidence noise with zero substantive findings; zero unresolved threads.
canonical_evidence.authority_boundary: Tool metadata contract, profile-gated registration and discovery, MCP annotations, and a narrower fs_list output bound. No tool, kernel shape, scope, approval class, or authority is added; remote discovery and fs_list output only narrow.
